subject: .claude/skills/review-work/SKILL.md:18
title: Make clear which words count as a yes
what: A checkpoint gives example words for approving, and the agent can end up repeating them as if they were required.
why: People start wondering whether their approval counts, and phrase their answers to fit a rule they can't see.
remedy: What would change: the checkpoint says any clear yes counts, or it asks with buttons so there is nothing to phrase.
detail: example replies 'yes, ship it', 'approved' — nothing says other wording works
